{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Kernel, adds btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time to the kernel API in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and eliminates global mocktime state to support multi-instance validation.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR introduces an instance-scoped clock API for ChainstateManager, eliminating process-global mock time state across concurrent kernel instances. It enables deterministic time-sensitive validation for external kernel callers and link-time enforcement against accidental nondeterministic clock usage."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to txmempool files are mechanical type standardizations to NodeClock::time_point without altering mempool policy, acceptance, or eviction rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/mempool.cpp purely for a one-line mechanical time-type adjustment.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The changes in test files adapt existing validation tests to the new clock API rather than modifying the test framework itself.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/util/time.h and time_nondet.cpp serve specifically to enforce libbitcoinkernel link-time boundaries rather than updating general node utility infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Validation, modifies src/validation.cpp and src/validation.h to route header future-time validation, IBD evaluation, and verification progress through ChainstateManager::Now().",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Routing validation time checks through ChainstateManager fixes an intermittent test race across second boundaries in chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks, where tip time and IsTipRecent() could diverge spuriously. Within validation, this is primarily internal plumbing to enable deterministic testing without altering consensus rules."
    }
  ],

  }
